step2b_second_migration_found_during_ste.finding: The first staging dry run (jobs.sense against taal_staging with the full bigquery_timesfm/bigquery backend) failed on write("gaps", ...) with "No such field: evidence.expiry_date". jobs/sense/gaps.py evidence dicts for online_sellby_breach/expiry_writeoff, stockout_risk, slow_mover, unmet_demand and assortment_gap gaps have ALWAYS emitted 14 real keys (expiry_date, online_sellby_date, sellby_passed, sku_name, category, node_type, lead_time_days, velocity_per_day, category_median_velocity, slow_mover_days, requesting_customer_ids, supply_node_id, garment_type, colour_family) that 14_gaps.sql never declared -- unrelated to the counterpart_gap_id fix, and much bigger in scope (affects the two largest gap types, ~80% of all gaps by volume). Found because this was the first time any of those gap types was ever written to real BigQuery.
step2b_second_migration_found_during_ste.fix: Same Method B, applied live: appended all 14 missing fields (all additive, nullable) to taal.gaps.evidence. 14_gaps.sql updated to match. infra/deploy.sh gained a permanent, idempotent migration step (bq show --schema | python3 stdlib patch | bq update) since CI has bq but no Python packages.
step2b_second_migration_found_during_ste.verified: Re-checked live: 0 missing fields against the full required list (26 total evidence subfields).

step2c_a_third_bug_found_in_bigquery_sto.finding: Separately, agents/gate/bigquery_store.py::write() was found to have its own bug: load_table_from_json with WRITE_TRUNCATE into an EXISTING table, given no explicit schema=, does not respect that table declared schema -- it infers a schema from the batch of rows being loaded, silently reordering a nested RECORD (STRUCT) column's subfields and DROPPING any subfield absent from every row in the batch. Reproduced directly against a real throwaway table: a 10-subfield STRUCT with only 10 of its 12 declared subfields present in the loaded row came back with those 2 missing subfields gone and the rest reordered.
step2c_a_third_bug_found_in_bigquery_sto.fix: write() now passes schema=<the real, unmodified schema fetched via get_table()> explicitly to LoadJobConfig. Verified the reordering/dropping stops when this is passed.
